name: I'm Tired of Being Alone
source:
Play as Mist, who has to kiss someone in five days or they become a frog. Simple as that.

[From [url=https://burgergutz.itch.io/im-tired-of-being-alone]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演米斯特——必须在五天之内亲吻某个人，否则就会变成一只青蛙。规则就是这么简单。

[摘自[url=https://burgergutz.itch.io/im-tired-of-being-alone]itch.io[/url]]
